scripts.setup: node server/scripts/check-node.cjs && npm run env:server && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:ready
scripts.setup:local: node server/scripts/check-node.cjs && npm run env:server && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix server && npm run prisma:seed --prefix server
scripts.db:up: node scripts/ensure-root-env.cjs && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.db:ready: npm run db:up && npm run env:server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix server && npm run prisma:seed --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
